steps.what: List agreed nursing terms the engineers already named.
Translate nursing practice information between nurses and systems engineers.
Record the object oriented model the specialist accepts.

tasks.design: Agreed nursing terms are listed from {DOCS} when the term id is already stored. The specialist translates practice information between nurses and systems engineers, and records an object oriented model only where it fits. A missing term id stops the list. The list does not translate the practice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Engineers and nurses used different words for the same ward event, and the glossary lived in one person's head.
tasks.enabler_now: A term both sides have already agreed can be listed before the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: A practice the glossary has no word for, and a model that would hide a nursing distinction.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can hear that the engineers' object is not the thing the nurse meant.
tasks.altitude: Agreed terms can be on the table. The specialist still translates the practice and still decides whether a model is honest.

reach.task: Start from a term both sides have already named, and still ask what the nurse meant.
reach.learn: The term list can be shared. The translation stays here.

evidence.claim: A nursing term both sides have already agreed can be listed. The list cannot translate a practice the glossary does not name.
The specialist decides what the model may say about nursing practice. A term list does not make that decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Term id, produced by the glossary the nurses and engineers have already accepted. A term that is not in that glossary is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the glossary the ward already maintains. Do not store a score of a nurse or an engineer.
unknowns: Which terms both sides have already accepted.
Which models the engineers are allowed to keep.
research_questions: What share of translations start from an agreed term?
Which practices have no agreed term?

already_counted.description: The specialist still translates the practice.
The specialist still accepts the model.

incremental.description: The specialist adds a term the glossary did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing nursing terms both sides have already agreed. It disappears when the term is missing and the specialist finds the wording. Translating the practice stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored clinical problems that already have an application id.
Design the health information technology application for that clinical problem.
Review how specialists implement the application before nurses use it.

tasks.design: Clinical problems with a stored application id are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist uses informatics science to design or implement the health information technology application, including an administrative case. A missing problem id stops the list. The list does not design the application.
tasks.previous_blocker: Application ideas were collected in meetings and the clinical problem was restated differently each time.
tasks.enabler_now: A problem that already has an application id can be listed before the design work.
tasks.still_hard: A clinical problem that does not fit the stored application, and an implementation nurses will not use.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can see that a stored problem is not the one the ward is actually trying to resolve.
tasks.altitude: Known problems can be listed. The specialist still designs the application and still reviews how it will be implemented.

reach.task: Hand over a named clinical problem, and still leave the application design with the specialist.
reach.learn: The problem id can be shared. The design stays here.

evidence.claim: A clinical problem that already has an application id can be listed. The list cannot design or implement the application.
The specialist decides how the application resolves the problem. A problem list does not put the application into use.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Problem id and application id, produced by the register the service already keeps. A problem with no application id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the problem register the service already keeps. The application is not switched on from this list.
unknowns: Which clinical problems already have an application id.
Who may put an application into ward use.
research_questions: What share of designs start from a stored problem id?
Which applications are built for a problem the register does not name?

already_counted.description: The specialist still designs the application.
The specialist still reviews the implementation.

incremental.description: The specialist writes up a problem the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing clinical problems that already have an application id. It disappears when the id is missing and the specialist writes the problem down. Designing and implementing the application stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List privacy headings the policy register already requires.
Develop practices that ensure the privacy of patient information.
Review confidentiality and security before the policy is adopted.

tasks.design: Privacy headings the register already requires are listed from {DOCS}. The specialist develops the practices that ensure privacy, confidentiality, and security of patient information. A heading with no policy id is not listed. The list does not decide what may be shared.
tasks.previous_blocker: Privacy sections were copied from the last policy and nobody checked which heading the register now requires.
tasks.enabler_now: A heading the register already requires can be listed before the specialist writes the practice.
tasks.still_hard: A disclosure the headings do not mention, and a practice staff will not follow.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can see that a complete heading list still leaves a patient exposed.
tasks.altitude: Required headings can be listed. The specialist still writes the privacy practice and still decides what may be shared.

reach.task: Start from the headings the register requires, and still write the rule about patient information here.
reach.learn: The heading list can be shared. The privacy decision stays here.

evidence.claim: A privacy heading the policy register already requires can be listed. The list cannot decide whether patient information may be shared.
The specialist writes the rule on who may see patient information. The list stores no score of a nurse or a patient.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Policy id and heading id, produced by the policy register. A heading the register does not require is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the policy register the organisation already keeps. Do not build a score of who opened a record.
unknowns: Which headings the register currently requires.
Who may adopt a privacy practice.
research_questions: What share of policies start from a required heading?
Which disclosures are never covered by the register?

already_counted.description: The specialist still writes the privacy practice.
The specialist still reviews confidentiality and security.

incremental.description: The specialist adds a heading the register did not require.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing privacy headings the register already requires. It disappears when the heading is missing and the specialist writes it. Deciding what may be shared stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored nursing measures already counted for the ward.
Analyze and interpret patient data to improve nursing services.
Record which information systems change the specialist accepts.

tasks.design: Nursing measures already counted for the ward are listed from {DATA_PLATFORM}. The specialist analyzes and interprets patient or nursing data to improve services. A measure with no ward id is not listed. The list does not interpret a patient.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ward counts were rebuilt in a sheet before anyone could say what they meant for nursing.
tasks.enabler_now: A measure the ward has already counted can be listed before the specialist reads it.
tasks.still_hard: A count that is complete and still means nothing for the patient in front of the nurse.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist can tell a busy week from a service that is failing.
tasks.altitude: Counted measures can be listed. The specialist still interprets them and still decides whether nursing services should change.

reach.task: Pass a counted measure with its ward id, and still leave the interpretation of the patient series here.
reach.learn: The measure can be listed. The reading stays here.

evidence.claim: A nursing measure the ward has already counted can be listed. The list cannot say what the measure means for a patient.
A figure is not a diagnosis and it does not change a service by itself. The specialist interprets it first.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A health informatics specialist in a mid-size European care organisation. A list does not interpret a patient, write a privacy rule, or enter a home.

Fields: Ward id and measure id, produced by the counts the ward already stores. A measure that has not been counted is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the informatics specialist finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open only the measures the specialist is already allowed to see. Do not propose a diagnosis from the list.
unknowns: Who may change a nursing service from an interpretation.
research_questions: What share of interpretations start from a counted measure?
Which service changes have no counted measure behind them?

already_counted.description: The specialist still interprets the patient data.
The specialist still accepts any systems change.

incremental.description: The specialist reconstructs a measure the platform did not count.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing nursing measures the ward has already counted. It disappears when the measure is missing and the specialist reconstructs it. Interpreting the patient data stays with the specialist.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The specialist still translates nursing practice, still writes the privacy rule, and still interprets patient data. A stored term or a stored measure can be listed first.
reach: Clinical data managers keep interpretation of a patient series with the clinician, and this job learns a stored measure is not a nursing judgement.
Information security analysts write the privacy rule themselves, and this job learns a heading list does not decide what may be shared.
skills_to_grow: Write the privacy rule, and do not let a heading list decide it.
Interpret patient data after the stored measures are listed.
role.ambitious_version: Stored terms and stored measures are listed before the specialist looks at them, and the privacy rule and the clinical reading stay with that person.
